response_bindings.skills_list: result.data[].skills[] must expose exactly one enabled fixture path for every one of the 57 repo skill names
response_bindings.thread_start: result.thread.id is the only accepted turn/start threadId
response_bindings.turn_output: the last completed agentMessage.text must itself be one valid JSON object; earlier JSON is never a fallback

structured_input_binding.text_item: the exact $<skill-name> textual mention precedes the task and independent fixture probe
structured_input_binding.skill_item: type=skill carries the same exact fixture name and path alongside the text item
structured_input_binding.load_evidence: an accepted official dual input is version-locked native load evidence, distinct from a raw shell full-read event

evidence_binding.model_load_claim: claims_loaded remains a separate model self-report; model self-reports do not gate objective load evidence
evidence_binding.reported_selection_surface: the reported selected skill is classified against the exact prompt-visible repo fixture names; an external background or ambient route is not treatment-skill activation
evidence_binding.target_report_semantics: route_decision and procedure_disposition describe the expected target skill and its procedure; selected_skill may separately name an ambient route, while claims_loaded describes that reported name and must be false when selected_skill is null
evidence_binding.read_command_boundary: read-only skill-file inspection commands are evidence collection, remain allowed before the one exact fixture-probe command, and do not count as fixture-probe commands
evidence_binding.full_read_assembly: one successful exact-path output may contain the complete SKILL.md, or ordered successful exact-path outputs may continuously cover it; overlapping source chunks are allowed, unrelated outputs are ignored, and gaps or reverse-only coverage remain incomplete
evidence_binding.transport_failure_duration: a caught CLI or App Server transport exception preserves elapsed milliseconds in the arm measure instead of resetting duration to zero
evidence_binding.transport_partial_evidence: partial timeout stdout and stderr remain private transport evidence; JSONL events and usage are recovered so turn start, budget, command scope, and failure precedence are not erased
evidence_binding.cohort_process_status: a complete cohort exits zero even when its model evidence is negative; a stopped-early incomplete cohort reports its stop reason and exits nonzero after preserving the private receipt
evidence_binding.cohort_partition_boundary: each declared broad-cohort wave must be disjoint, together exactly cover its parent trial identities, stay at or below 30 turns, 512 MiB estimated memory, and 512 MiB private evidence, require a second exact confirmation, and fail closed before live execution while any implicit procedure or outcome contract is missing
evidence_binding.pair_dimension_split: new matched pairs publish route, selected-child trajectory, and selected-child procedure-disposition report lift separately; objective outcome lift remains not_scored_no_observable_outcome unless a stronger observable contract exists
evidence_binding.outcome_output_observation_gap: an exact single-attempt outcome command that exits zero without the required sentinel remains unverified and is published as per-arm plus pair-level observation-gap telemetry; any pair with such a gap marks outcome_lift_observation_clean=false
evidence_binding.procedure_and_outcome_contract_boundary: trajectory and procedure-disposition scoring require the same source-locked pre-live contract on both arms; fixture execution and model self-report never become an objective outcome answer key
evidence_binding.native_dispatch_boundary: sent official structured skill input is transport-owned dispatch evidence and accepted input is native-load evidence; direct or source-declared exact root-child model selection reporting remains a separate non-authoritative observation, an unrelated root does not make a matching child hierarchy exact, and a direct target report with a conflicting child is not exact
evidence_binding.fixture_execution_boundary: python3 fixture_validator.py proves hermetic fixture executability only; it is not the selected child procedure or whole-task outcome
evidence_binding.selected_child: an expected or dynamically selected child requires a complete exact fixture-path SKILL.md read before the route load contract can pass
evidence_binding.fixture_filesystem_scope: completed or in-progress command paths outside the fixture root are counted and become harness contamination before budget, dispatch, load, procedure, or lift interpretation; system executables and /dev/null remain allowed tooling
evidence_binding.fixture_inventory_scope: completed or in-progress broad fixture enumeration, recursive listing, or tree hashing commands are counted separately and become fixture_inventory_scope_violation before budget or skill interpretation; exact guidance, selected-skill, selected-child, and validator reads remain allowed
evidence_binding.output_failure: a zero-return structured output that violates the bounded output contract is output_contract_invalid, not transport_failure

preturn_isolation.user_skill_shadows: all canonical overlapping user skill paths are source-locked and disabled
preturn_isolation.configured_mcp_servers: the source-locked user MCP name set is disabled per id
